definitions.explanation: The Emperor of Japan and his family. Refers to the institution and the family collectively.

examples.japanese: {皇室|こうしつ}の{行事|ぎょうじ}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: An imperial household ceremony was held.

examples.japanese: {皇室|こうしつ}の{方々|かたがた}は{多|おお}くの{公務|こうむ}をこなされている。
examples.english: Members of the imperial family carry out many official duties.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{皇室|こうしつ}は{世界|せかい}で{最|もっと}も{長|なが}い{歴史|れきし}を{持|も}つ{王室|おうしつ}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: The Japanese imperial household is said to be the oldest royal family in the world.

notes:
{皇室|こうしつ} refers to the Japanese imperial family as an institution.

WORD FORMATION:
{皇|こう} (emperor) + {室|しつ} (house, chamber)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皇室|こうしつ}{典範|てんぱん}: Imperial House Law
- {皇室|こうしつ}{行事|ぎょうじ}: imperial household events
- {皇室|こうしつ}の{方々|かたがた}: members of the imperial family

RELATED:
- {天皇|てんのう}: the Emperor
- {王室|おうしつ}: royal family (for non-Japanese monarchies)
